title: Canonical integral Tate-twisted pullback and localizing restrictions
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite intermediate extension E of Q_ell in its algebraic closure. For a scheme X let tateLine(X,d) be the inverse section-module equivalence applied to the published signed integral Tate twist [sk-def-sp-tate-twist]. For f:X -> Y and d natural define pullTwistShift as derived pullback followed by derived right tensor with tateLine(X,d) in degree zero and shift by 2d. Define restrictedPull and restrictedPush by full-subcategory lifting to the recorded Loc(Dbc) [sk-def-localizing-closure], given preservation proofs. Define brownComparison(f,G) to mean that for every boundary compactification and its preservation proof, every right adjoint J of its restricted compact-support image is naturally isomorphic to G. These are exactly the five existing definitions, with no choice of Brown adjoint.
